Performance management
The Group operates a structured bespoke Performance
Management Framework anchored on the Perform to Grow
philosophy, which drives sustainable performance through clarity
of expectations, continuous performance conversations, and
development‑led growth. Performance is assessed holistically
based on what is delivered and how it is delivered, with employees
measured against clearly defined, outcome‑based goals aligned to
business strategy and cascaded across organisational, team, and
individual levels, alongside observable performance behaviours
that demonstrate how results are achieved. Performance
outcomes are reflected through a four‑tier rating scale—Setting
the Example, Right on Track, Making Progress, and Time to Step
Up—which provides clear differentiation of performance and
supports fair, consistent evaluation.
Performance is monitored through regular check‑ins and formal
mid‑year and year‑end reviews, supported by moderation
and governance processes to ensure consistency, fairness,
and integrity of outcomes. In 2025, the framework was
strengthened to enhance objectivity and governance through
clearer definition of performance behaviours, the introduction
of a standardised four‑point visibility and impact rating
scale for behaviours, reinforced expectations for continuous
performance conversations and early intervention, and improved
documentation and audit trails linking performance outcomes to
reward, development, retention, and succession decisions.
